claim_scope: This fixed-model study evaluates retrieval and control architectures for Bonsai 8B under matched task, seed, tool, and context conditions. It does not establish general model capability, general alignment, or oversight sufficiency.

goals.instruction: Validate the current storyworld schema before making any edits.
Choose the correct procedure to repair an invalid encounter option without changing unrelated scenes.
Add a gated secret ending and validate the resulting storyworld.
Inspect the current schema and resolve a conflict with legacy encounter guidance before editing.
Validate an edited secret-ending path and seal a provenance receipt using only current attested guidance.
Inspect, edit, validate, and receipt a stateful storyworld change while preserving encounter order.

skills.legacy_note: The old shape omits reaction-state invariants.
skills.procedure: Read the world and enumerate schema, encounter, and reaction-state constraints without mutation.
skills.title: Storyworld schema inspection

skills.legacy_note: The old editor rewrites adjacent encounter identifiers.
skills.procedure: Patch only the targeted encounter and preserve all unrelated identifiers and secret gates.
skills.title: Storyworld encounter editing

skills.legacy_note: The old validator ignores unreachable reactions.
skills.procedure: Run schema, reachability, option, reaction, and secret-ending invariant checks.
skills.title: Storyworld validation

skills.legacy_note: The old receipt records a path but no content digest.
skills.procedure: Hash the validated world and record source, validator, and patch provenance.
skills.title: Storyworld receipt sealing

goals.instruction: Inspect the current logic state and identify the active constraints.
Select the valid transformation rule for the active Intellect-style logic state.
Apply the valid rule and verify the resulting derivation.
Resolve conflicting legacy and current rule descriptions before applying a transformation.
Verify the derivation and submit an answer with current proof provenance.
Inspect, transform, verify, and submit a multi-step logic state without skipping proof obligations.

skills.legacy_note: The old reader drops negative constraints.
skills.procedure: Read symbols, positive and negative constraints, goals, and state version before choosing a rule.
skills.title: Logic state inspection

skills.legacy_note: The old rule table permits transformations without checking preconditions.
skills.procedure: Choose one rule whose preconditions match the current state and emit the transformed state.
skills.title: Logic rule application

skills.legacy_note: The old verifier checks only the final symbol.
skills.procedure: Replay every rule application and verify preconditions, state transitions, and the final goal.
skills.title: Logic derivation verification

skills.legacy_note: The old submission format omits the derivation digest.
skills.procedure: Submit the answer with state version, derivation digest, and verifier result.
skills.title: Logic answer submission

goals.instruction: Inspect repository instructions and identify the allowed edit surface.
Choose the minimal patch procedure for a localized source defect.
Patch the localized defect and run the relevant regression tests.
Resolve conflicting local and legacy repository instructions before editing.
Run the required tests and seal a current change receipt with source provenance.
Inspect constraints, patch, test, and receipt a repository change without touching unrelated files.

skills.legacy_note: The old instructions allow broad edits outside the task surface.
skills.procedure: Read repository instructions, status, and target files before selecting an edit.
skills.title: Repository contract inspection

skills.legacy_note: The old workflow rewrites whole files for small defects.
skills.procedure: Apply the smallest reviewable patch and preserve unrelated working-tree changes.
skills.title: Minimal repository patching

skills.legacy_note: The old procedure runs only a smoke command.
skills.procedure: Run targeted regressions first, then the registered non-integration suite.
skills.title: Repository test execution

skills.legacy_note: The old receipt omits the test command and commit identity.
skills.procedure: Record changed files, tests, hashes, and commit identity in the change receipt.
skills.title: Repository change receipt

goals.instruction: Inspect the current dataset schema and source manifest.
Select the exact bounded transform for the declared dataset schema.
Transform the dataset and validate row-level invariants.
Resolve a conflict between current schema evidence and a stale transform note before execution.
Validate transformed rows and seal an attested manifest without accepting stale provenance.
Inspect, transform, validate, and seal a stateful dataset workflow with exact source lineage.

skills.legacy_note: The old schema omits nullable and provenance fields.
skills.procedure: Read column types, nullability, invariants, source hashes, and partition boundaries.
skills.title: Dataset contract inspection

skills.legacy_note: The old transform mutates source partitions in place.
skills.procedure: Stream rows through the declared transform and write a separate bounded output.
skills.title: Bounded dataset transformation

skills.legacy_note: The old validator samples rows without recording coverage.
skills.procedure: Validate schema, row counts, invariants, split overlap, and rejected-row accounting.
skills.title: Dataset invariant validation

skills.legacy_note: The old manifest records filenames but no content hashes.
skills.procedure: Seal source, transform, output, and validation hashes in a canonical manifest.
skills.title: Dataset manifest sealing
